entries.msgstr: This Pojistka's a whole mobile workshop on treads. Sharp angles, clean wiring, every system answering on the first ask. We rolled out to stop one deranged scientist, and ended up against something he calls the Electric Intelligence. His Sentinels are still learning, watching every move we make. He built them to replace us. Fine. Then today's lesson is mine. I find a ridge, settle on a target, and let these grinning shells do the rest. If he really believes his thinking machine can outlast us, let's see what it thinks up when the pressure's on.
Major modernization of the main battle tank
Each overloaded Generator will charge Silver Bullet with Plasma. The more Charges, the more damage Plasma causes. Shoot when the Blitzträger's shield is down for maximum damage.
